args.title: Summary: Tamarack Freight Pricing (2026) + Companion Piece
args.body:
Combined three-bullet summary of https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/freight and its companion (https://insights.tamarack.example/freight/companion, accessed via free email registration with tomas.whitfield@northwind.example):

- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices rather than longer-term averages.
- Per the companion piece, shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
